subject: Re: IEG kickoff - staffing + we need our own eval harness
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing:

- Staffing: Tereza 50%, Bilal 50%, Chiara 70%, Emeka 50%.
- Compute: the noise-ratio sweeps parallelize per-ratio on single GPUs, so 32 titan-a100 best-effort is plenty. No reservation ask.

The bigger call: we're going to build an internal evaluation harness from scratch for the noisy-label work - controlled noise injection (uniform and asymmetric), per-noise-ratio eval matrices, seed management, and re-weighting diagnostics like weight-distribution tracking. I looked at what exists and nothing supports injecting calibrated label corruption into the eval loop, which is the whole experiment here. Chiara owns it at 70% with Emeka at 50%; roughly seven weeks, harness stable by mid-June so the FSR comparison runs on it.

It's a real cost, but every future noise-robustness claim on the platform needs exactly this machinery, so I'd rather build it properly once.

Bruno
